strings.Warmer colours at night: a panel-level t: Warmer colours at night: a panel-level tint over the menu and the games; Warmer cuts more blue.
strings.Plays the theme's sounds by number. Left: Plays the theme's sounds by number. Left and right pick one, L and R by ten, A plays it.
strings.Type part of a name. START looks it up:: Type part of a name. START looks it up: the games found open as a shelf of their own. An empty search takes the shelf away.
strings.L for symbols, START joins. The password: L for symbols, START joins. The password is kept in banana/wifi.conf on the card.
strings.L for symbols, START when it is typed. A: L for symbols, START when it is typed. Accounts are kept in banana/accounts.conf on the card.
strings.The whole look of the menu: Classic, or: The whole look of the menu: Classic, or SNES (Banana Street). Theme then picks its colours.
strings.The menu's look: one of the themes here,: The menu's look: one of the themes here, or your own: a .json in banana/themes on the card (banana/themes/README.txt says how).
strings.The language of the Settings screen: Eng: The language of the Settings screen: English, Spanish or German. The other screens follow in a later update.
strings.The panel's backlight: F + volume, in th: The panel's backlight: F + volume, in the menu and in a game.
strings.The speakers or the headphones, whicheve: The speakers or the headphones, whichever is playing. The volume keys change it anywhere.
strings.The menu's clicks, and the click as the: The menu's clicks, and the click as the boot logo lands.
strings.An ambient loop under the menu, mixed lo: An ambient loop under the menu, mixed low. A bgm.wav (or music/bgm.wav) on the card plays instead. Off stops it.
strings.The battery in the status bar: its icon,: The battery in the status bar: its icon, or its icon and how full it is.
strings.How the time in the status bar is writte: How the time in the status bar is written.
strings.The banana wordmark flying in while Bana: The banana wordmark flying in while Banana Pocket starts. Off goes straight to the menu once it is ready.
strings.In the menu, after this long with no but: In the menu, after this long with no button pressed. Never while a game is running.
strings.Keeps sound ready through a sleep, so a: Keeps sound ready through a sleep, so a game has audio the instant it wakes, for about 12 mA more while asleep.
strings.In the menu, the panel goes down to a th: In the menu, the panel goes down to a third after this long with no button pressed, and back at the first press. Never while a game is running.
strings.Softcore keeps save states, rewind and c: Softcore keeps save states, rewind and cheats. Hardcore locks them, and unlocks count as hardcore on retroachievements.org.
strings.On: quitting keeps where you are and the: On: quitting keeps where you are and the game resumes there next time (not in Hardcore). Off: a game starts from its title.
strings.The emulator for GBA games. gpSP: the fa: The emulator for GBA games. gpSP: the fastest. mGBA: the most accurate, and the one RetroAchievements accepts for hardcore.
strings.The emulator for PlayStation games. Swan: The emulator for PlayStation games. SwanStation (DuckStation): hardware rendering and much greater accuracy, heavier. PCSX-ReARMed: lightest, and the one to fall back to when a game is slow.
strings.The emulator for NES games. FCEUmm: the: The emulator for NES games. FCEUmm: the lightest. NEStopia: more accurate, a little heavier.
strings.The emulator for SNES games. Snes9x: fas: The emulator for SNES games. Snes9x: fast, and the usual choice. bsnes: cycle-accurate, much heavier.
strings.The emulator for Game Boy games. Gambatt: The emulator for Game Boy games. Gambatte: fast and accurate. SameBoy: the most accurate, and the one that renders the original LCD best.
strings.The emulator for Game Boy Color games. G: The emulator for Game Boy Color games. Gambatte: fast and accurate. SameBoy: the most accurate.
strings.The emulator for Mega Drive games. PicoD: The emulator for Mega Drive games. PicoDrive: the lightest (32X too). Genesis Plus GX: more accurate for Mega CD.
strings.The emulator for Game Gear games. Genesi: The emulator for Game Gear games. Genesis Plus GX: more accurate. PicoDrive: the lightest (Mega Drive and 32X too).
strings.The emulator for N64 games. Mupen64Plus-: The emulator for N64 games. Mupen64Plus-Next: the usual choice, with its own GLideN64. ParaLLEl N64: the alternative.
strings.The networks around: press A to join one: The networks around: press A to join one, typing the password on the keyboard or by touch. 802.1X needs banana/wifi.conf.
strings.The clock's time zone, summer time inclu: The clock's time zone, summer time included, for the menu and the games. The time itself comes from Wi-Fi or the handheld's own clock.
strings.Writes a new version to the other slot,: Writes a new version to the other slot, used from the next restart. Gets the latest release over Wi-Fi, or banana/updates.
strings.Settings, accounts, saves, states and co: Settings, accounts, saves, states and controller remaps in one file in banana/backups. Games and art stay out. Press A twice.
strings.Unpacks the newest backup over the card': Unpacks the newest backup over the card's settings, saves and states, then restarts the menu so they are read. Press A twice.
strings.Covers, titles, genres and years from li: Covers, titles, genres and years from libretro's free collections (Wi-Fi). Skips games that have art. Runs only on the charger.
strings.libretro: its own collections. + Twiligh: libretro: its own collections. + Twilight: TwilightBoxart fills the gaps. Twilight first: TwilightBoxart's covers, then libretro's.
strings.Restarts into the other slot: the versio: Restarts into the other slot: the version that ran before the last update. Press A twice.
strings.The card's games and saves as a USB disk: The card's games and saves as a USB disk on the computer over the cable. Read-only copies off the card; Read-write (transfer mode) stops the menu and hands the card over until you eject it.
strings.Games on the card in the second slot (it: Games on the card in the second slot (its roms folder, with the same system folders as this card) show up in the library with the others while it's in. exFAT or FAT32.
strings.In a game, volume, brightness, low batte: In a game, volume, brightness, low battery and achievements show as a line; pulling the headphones pauses. Off: just the game.
strings.The steps from the first boot again: Wi-: The steps from the first boot again: Wi-Fi, the time zone and the RetroAchievements account.
strings.Puts menu, display, sound, power and net: Puts menu, display, sound, power and network settings back to default. Games and card are untouched. Press A twice.
strings.Puts the emulator choices back to their: Puts the emulator choices back to their defaults: the core.<system> picks. Your menu and card settings stay. Press A twice.
strings.In the SNES style, a game's box on the c: In the SNES style, a game's box on the counter: drawn on the street's grid in the Super NES's colours, or the picture as it is.
No save states for this game.
strings.A frame around the game. Game Boy system: A frame around the game. Game Boy systems default to their own; choose others here, or in a game's options. Off removes all.
strings.A CRT or LCD pattern over the menu and g: A CRT or LCD pattern over the menu and games. The panel is OLED and a mask stays put for hours, so leave it off if unsure.
strings.With a CRT mask on: the picture collapse: With a CRT mask on: the picture collapses to a dot on sleep, and wakes with a degauss thump and a 20 s warm-up.
strings.Save your game now. Banana Pocket closes: Save your game now. Banana Pocket closes it and shuts down at
strings.Plug in the charger soon. Banana Pocket: Plug in the charger soon. Banana Pocket closes the game and shuts down at
strings.Restarts into the other system slot, the: Restarts into the other system slot, the version that ran before the last update. Press A twice.
strings.Checks and repairs the games partition,: Checks and repairs the games partition, then returns to the menu. Press A twice.
strings.Hands the card to the computer over USB-: Hands the card to the computer over USB-C until you eject it. Press A twice.
